import pyagrum as gum
bn = gum.BayesNet("Dying houseplant")
bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("winter", "", ["yes", "no"])) bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("drainage hole", "Does the pot have a drainage hole?", ["yes", "no"])) bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("light", "How much light the plant gets", ["bright", "dim"])) bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("watering", "How much the plant is watered for this time of year", ["too much", "about right", "too little"])) bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("soil feels wet", "", ["yes", "no"])) bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("root rot", "", ["yes", "no"])) bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("drooping", "", ["yes", "no"])) bn.add(gum.LabelizedVariable("yellow leaves", "", ["yes", "no"]))
bn.addArc("winter", "light") bn.addArc("winter", "watering") bn.addArc("watering", "soil feels wet") bn.addArc("drainage hole", "soil feels wet") bn.addArc("watering", "root rot") bn.addArc("drainage hole", "root rot") bn.addArc("watering", "drooping") bn.addArc("root rot", "drooping") bn.addArc("root rot", "yellow leaves") bn.addArc("light", "yellow leaves")
bn.cpt("winter").fillWith([0.25, 0.75])
bn.cpt("drainage hole").fillWith([0.8, 0.2])
bn.cpt("light")[{"winter": "yes"}] = [0.4, 0.6] bn.cpt("light")[{"winter": "no"}] = [0.75, 0.25]
bn.cpt("watering")[{"winter": "yes"}] = [0.4, 0.5, 0.1] bn.cpt("watering")[{"winter": "no"}] = [0.2, 0.6, 0.2]
bn.cpt("soil feels wet")[{"watering": "too much", "drainage hole": "yes"}] = [0.85, 0.15] bn.cpt("soil feels wet")[{"watering": "too much", "drainage hole": "no"}] = [0.97, 0.03] bn.cpt("soil feels wet")[{"watering": "about right", "drainage hole": "yes"}] = [0.3, 0.7] bn.cpt("soil feels wet")[{"watering": "about right", "drainage hole": "no"}] = [0.6, 0.4] bn.cpt("soil feels wet")[{"watering": "too little", "drainage hole": "yes"}] = [0.02, 0.98] bn.cpt("soil feels wet")[{"watering": "too little", "drainage hole": "no"}] = [0.05, 0.95]
bn.cpt("root rot")[{"watering": "too much", "drainage hole": "yes"}] = [0.3, 0.7] bn.cpt("root rot")[{"watering": "too much", "drainage hole": "no"}] = [0.6, 0.4] bn.cpt("root rot")[{"watering": "about right", "drainage hole": "yes"}] = [0.02, 0.98] bn.cpt("root rot")[{"watering": "about right", "drainage hole": "no"}] = [0.1, 0.9] bn.cpt("root rot")[{"watering": "too little", "drainage hole": "yes"}] = [0.01, 0.99] bn.cpt("root rot")[{"watering": "too little", "drainage hole": "no"}] = [0.01, 0.99]
bn.cpt("drooping")[{"watering": "too much", "root rot": "yes"}] = [0.85, 0.15] bn.cpt("drooping")[{"watering": "too much", "root rot": "no"}] = [0.3, 0.7] bn.cpt("drooping")[{"watering": "about right", "root rot": "yes"}] = [0.85, 0.15] bn.cpt("drooping")[{"watering": "about right", "root rot": "no"}] = [0.05, 0.95] bn.cpt("drooping")[{"watering": "too little", "root rot": "yes"}] = [0.95, 0.05] bn.cpt("drooping")[{"watering": "too little", "root rot": "no"}] = [0.8, 0.2]
bn.cpt("yellow leaves")[{"root rot": "yes", "light": "bright"}] = [0.7, 0.3] bn.cpt("yellow leaves")[{"root rot": "yes", "light": "dim"}] = [0.8, 0.2] bn.cpt("yellow leaves")[{"root rot": "no", "light": "bright"}] = [0.05, 0.95] bn.cpt("yellow leaves")[{"root rot": "no", "light": "dim"}] = [0.35, 0.65]
